baseline_models.focus_anchor: The participial address al-muddaththir is anchored in د ث ر as an outer wrap laid over an inner garment.
baseline_models.mechanism: The vocative identifies the addressee by a state of being covered, making enclosure rather than a personal name the focus ayah's initial condition.

activation_trace.role: The outer wrap over an inner garment supplies the literal covered condition by which the addressee is hailed.

changed_reading.before: A bare vocative translated only as 'O cloaked one.'
changed_reading.after: A vocative that deliberately fixes the recipient at a threshold while still enclosed by an outer covering.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Al-muddaththir remains attached to the focus participle, while the د ث ر inventory adds the image of a hidden, idle, sleepy man.
baseline_models.mechanism: Covering can function as withdrawal: the address singles out concealed or dormant agency before any context explains what must replace it.

activation_trace.role: The hidden, inactive, sleepy figure turns the wrap into a posture of withdrawn agency.

changed_reading.after: The clothing may diagnose concealment and inactivity, so the vocative addresses a condition poised for reversal.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same focus root includes traces covered over and hearts or souls losing remembrance.
baseline_models.mechanism: The participial address may carry an undertone of occluded trace or memory: not only a body under cloth, but a presence at risk of being covered out of notice.

activation_trace.role: Effaced traces and remembrance lost under covering supply an exploratory memory-and-visibility layer to the address.

changed_reading.after: The address may also name a covered-over trace or remembrance that can be recovered.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus root's abundance branch associates د ث ر with piled-up wealth and abundance generally.
baseline_models.mechanism: The epithet can provisionally profile someone surrounded by accumulation, allowing material surplus to coexist with the literal garment reading without replacing it.

activation_trace.role: Piled-up wealth supplies a latent abundance profile within the focus epithet.

changed_reading.before: The epithet refers only to fabric around the addressee.
changed_reading.after: The epithet can tentatively evoke being surrounded by abundance as well as by cloth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The hidden, idle posture is immediately reversed by resolute rising, and the warning gives that emergence a public purpose: awakening caution in others.

activation_trace.role: The hidden, inactive, sleepy figure supplies the private withdrawal that is reversed.
Resolute rising to an undertaking converts dormant enclosure into deliberate agency.
A warning that awakens caution supplies the outward function of the rise.

structural_cues: 74:1 is followed immediately by the paired imperatives 'rise' and 'warn'.
The focus is a vocative state-description; 74:2 supplies the first actions that reverse and redirect that state.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealed inactivity, resolute rising, and caution-awakening warning; I infer the directional arrow from private enclosure to public agency. The literal possibility that the garment is only a circumstantial address remains live.

changed_reading.before: An affectionate or descriptive address to someone under a wrap.
changed_reading.after: A threshold summons that catches withdrawn agency at the instant it must stand up and become warning-bearing agency.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus covering is not simply discarded. The nearby garment and purification branches recast covering as a surface, and metonymically a self, that must be cleared of accumulated neglect before public action.

activation_trace.role: The outer wrap supplies the material surface linked to the later garment command.
Grime or rust from neglected polishing supplies the recoverable accretion on that surface.
Garment, including what can stand metonymically for the self, makes the focus wrap ethically as well as materially legible.
Purity as removal of dirt supplies the restorative operation applied to the covering.

structural_cues: The garment-purification command at 74:4 follows the rise, magnification, and warning sequence.
74:5 then extends the sequence with an imperative of separation from al-rujz.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an outer wrap, neglect-produced grime, garment/self metonymy, and removal of dirt; I infer that the focus covering is to be reconditioned for mission rather than merely thrown off. Garment purification may alternatively remain an independent command with no backward effect on 74:1.

changed_reading.before: The wrap is an obstacle left behind when the addressee rises.
changed_reading.after: The wrap becomes a recoverable public surface: coveredness must be cleaned and rightly ordered, not treated as intrinsically impure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The latent wealth sense of the focus root is disciplined by a ban on burdening recipients in pursuit of increase, then contrasted with the later portrait of a man given abundant wealth who still wants more.

activation_trace.role: Piled-up wealth supplies the focus epithet's latent abundance profile.
Burdening a beneficiary by rehearsing one's favor defines the transactional misuse of giving.
Growth in number supplies the sought increase that can corrupt benefaction.
Possession and abundance of wealth externalize the accumulation profile in the later negative portrait.

structural_cues: 74:6 joins giving, reminder of favor, and seeking increase in one compact prohibition.
74:11-15 portrays solitary creation followed by extended wealth and an appetite for further increase.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies piled wealth, favor used as leverage, numerical increase, and abundant property; I infer a contrast between entrusted abundance and self-amplifying accumulation. The focus B001 branch may instead be etymological background with no intended force in the participle.

changed_reading.before: Al-muddaththir identifies only a person wrapped in cloth.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it also addresses an abundance-bearing agent whose service must not turn generosity into leverage for greater accumulation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later oath stages a macro-version of the focus transition: darkness covers, night passes behind, morning arrives, and dawn removes the veil. The personal wrap becomes a small-scale threshold between concealment and disclosure.

activation_trace.role: The outer wrap supplies the personal-scale covering whose cosmic analogue is tested.
Night and its darkness supply the large-scale field of concealment.
The ending and passing of a thing gives the dark covering a temporal limit.
The first light of day supplies the successor state after concealment.
Removing a covering makes dawn's disclosure an explicit unveiling operation.

structural_cues: 74:32-36 moves from moon, through retreating night and unveiling dawn, to the renewed designation of warning.
The night/dawn pair is a temporal reversal rather than a static contrast.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bodily wrapping, night darkness, passing, morning, and removal of a veil; I infer a microcosm-to-macrocosm analogy in which 74:1 occupies the pre-dawn threshold. The oath imagery can alternatively function without referring back to the addressee's garment.

changed_reading.before: The addressee happens to be wrapped at one private moment.
changed_reading.after: The wrapped moment foreshadows a patterned passage from concealment to disclosure, like night yielding when dawn unveils.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated reminder and remembering at the close directly reverse the focus root's exploratory image of traces effaced and remembrance lost. The addressee emerges as a carrier through whom covered-over memory is restored.

activation_trace.role: Effaced traces and forgotten hearts supply the loss-state that the closing remembrance sequence reverses.
A reminder as that which makes one remember supplies the restorative instrument.
Bringing something to mind after forgetting supplies the actual reversal of effacement.

structural_cues: The reminder root recurs at 74:31, 74:49, and in every ayah from 74:54 through 74:56.
The close shifts from people turning away from the reminder to the possibility and dependency of remembering it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies forgotten or effaced trace and an unusually dense reminder/remembering close; I infer that the opening epithet names a reversible memory-state and that the addressee mediates its reversal. The literal garment remains the stronger morphological reading.

changed_reading.before: The opening wrap concerns bodily concealment alone.
changed_reading.after: The opening can also prefigure a mission of recovering covered-over remembrance and making an effaced warning present again.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening figure is summoned out of hidden inactivity, while the closing audience turns aside, recoils, and flees from reminder. The addressee becomes the social counter-image to evasive motion.

activation_trace.role: The hidden, inactive figure supplies the opening posture from which a contrary response is demanded.
Turning one's side away supplies deliberate refusal of the reminder.
Recoil and distancing intensify refusal into bodily separation.
Flight completes the audience's movement away and supplies the negative mirror of rising to warn.

structural_cues: 74:49-51 accelerates from turning away, to startled distancing, to outright flight.
This audience sequence answers the opening movement from covered stillness to commanded action with an opposite movement away from reminder.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opening hidden inactivity and a closing sequence of turning, recoiling, and flight; I infer a social counter-image between the summoned addressee and the evasive audience. The two scenes may alternatively characterize unrelated actors without deliberate mirroring.

changed_reading.before: The opening addresses one individual's temporary inactivity.
changed_reading.after: The opening commissions a counter-posture: emerge from concealment and face the reminder precisely where the audience turns and runs away.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final ayah distinguishes protective covering from withdrawn self-covering. Prevention of harm and a cover that preserves revalue the opening wrap: the trajectory is not from all covering to exposure, but from enclosure to rightly sourced protection.

activation_trace.role: The outer wrap supplies the opening form of bodily protection and enclosure.
Placing the self within protection supplies a beneficial counterpart to self-enclosure.
A cover that preserves what it covers supplies protection without the inertia of the opening posture.

structural_cues: The surah closes by predicating both taqwa and maghfirah of God in 74:56.
Protective enclosure therefore appears at both ends, but with different agents and functions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an outer wrap, self-protection, and preservative covering; I infer a transformation from self-enclosing cover to divinely grounded protection. The final terms may alternatively bear no backward spatial relation to al-muddaththir.

changed_reading.before: Mission requires simply leaving cover for exposure.
changed_reading.after: Mission requires exchanging inert self-enclosure for a protective covering that preserves while permitting action.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the form-distant د ث ر image of a rider mounting over an animal rather than the ordinary garment sense. It remains anchored in the focus root and is directionally activated by rising and advancing, but downstream prose should present it only as a spatial resonance of gaining active command, never as a lexical translation of al-muddaththir.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus participle carries the د ث ر branch image of mounting over like a covering.

activation_trace.role: Mounting above like a cover supplies an odd shift from being enclosed to taking an active upper position.
Resolute rising to an undertaking supplies the first directional activation of mounted agency.
Forward advance and precedence extend the image from rising into directed movement.

changed_reading.before: The covered one is only beneath or inside what covers him.
changed_reading.after: As a contained spatial resonance, the epithet can pivot toward one who rises above passivity and assumes directed, advancing agency.

strongest_changes: The immediate rise-and-warn pair converts the hidden wrapped posture into public, caution-awakening agency.
Garment purification reconditions the opening cover as a public and ethical surface rather than merely an obstacle.
The dense closing remembrance sequence reverses the focus root's branch of effaced traces and forgotten hearts.
The final protection and preservative-cover branches distinguish inert enclosure from covering that enables and preserves action.
summary.what_was_special: A one-root, two-word focus ayah generated several coherent trajectories because later context repeatedly reverses or revalues covering: standing replaces inertia, purification removes accretion, dawn unveils darkness, reminder recovers effacement, and protection restores a beneficial form of cover.
remaining_uncertainties: The literal outer-garment branch is morphologically strongest; the wealth, effacement, rust, and mounting branches remain layered activations rather than replacement glosses.
The night-to-dawn and final-protection readings depend on reader-supplied analogies across distant parts of the surah.
The abundance reading is supported by repeated accumulation language but may reflect root inventory resonance rather than force in the focus participle.
